explainBack.question: Why doesn't the new $4 input / $20 output token pricing make a Pro subscriber's monthly Claude bill cheaper?
explainBack.answer: Because two separate meters run on two separate billing channels. A Pro subscription charges a flat monthly fee and meters usage as an allowance inside a five-hour window that resets; token prices meter the volume of text processed and are charged per use only to developers who pay Anthropic directly through the API. Changing the per-token rate alters what a developer pays per unit of text, but a subscriber never pays per token, so their bill is untouched — what changed for them is a larger (unquantified) five-hour allowance and a saveable reset.
